summary: The ultimate meta-skill for OpenClaw. Automatically analyzes, diagnoses, and upgrades ANY existing skill to elite/legendary tier. Use this skill when you need to enhance, refactor, or evolve any skill — whether it's writing, coding, research, analysis, or custom skills. This skill injects upgrade protocols, quality gates, and enhancement layers that transform basic skills into world-class cognitive systems. Think of it as a "skill compiler" that optimizes every aspect of another skill's architecture, reasoning depth, output quality, and execution precision.
